description: List campaigns, newest first, a page at a time, with how many steps, leads and connected sending mailboxes each has. Filter by status or search names with `q`. The search is a literal substring, with case ignored and accents kept. Both filters apply before pagination; keep the same filters with a cursor.

cursor.description: Where the last page stopped: the nextCursor of the answer before. Use it with the same filters it came with. Left out, the list starts at the beginning.

limit.description: How many to return in one page, 1 to 200. Left out, the server picks.

q.description: Find campaign names containing this text, up to 200 characters. Case is ignored, accents are kept and %, _ and backslash match themselves. Outer spaces are trimmed; blank means all names. Combine with status to narrow further. Keep the same q and status when paging with a cursor.

name: list_campaigns
title: List campaigns
